title: Section cards
intro: A block can sit on a coloured card (“Background” button on the page). This is what it gets when the card is turned on with nothing else chosen. Blocks without a card do not change.
colorHelp: A theme colour or a soft shade follows palette changes.
textOk: The text reads well on this card.
textBad: The text is hard to read on this colour ({ratio}:1, 4.5:1 is needed).
borderAuto: Default: the colour of the card's text
borderHelp: The border follows the card's corners; thin, medium or thick. With no colour chosen, it takes the colour of the card's text, always legible on it.
